title: Virtual Singapore
description: Documented public national digital twin (Singapore NRF) for the City Digital Twin Builder capability area.
body:
Virtual Singapore is a documented national digital twin from Singapore NRF. The pioneering authoritative 3D city model of Singapore integrating buildings, infrastructure, and sensor data for planning.

How it works: It works by stepping hour by hour, charging storage on surplus and discharging on deficit, and reporting any unmet demand.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.

title: UrbanFootprint
description: Documented public urban planning data (UrbanFootprint) for the City Digital Twin Builder capability area.
body:
UrbanFootprint is a documented urban planning data from UrbanFootprint. Parcel-level urban data platform used by California planners to model land use, risk, and climate scenarios.

How it works: It works by projecting the logistic growth curve from the initial population toward the carrying capacity.

title: Replica
description: Documented public mobility simulation (Replica (Sidewalk spinout)) for the City Digital Twin Builder capability area.
body:
Replica is a documented mobility simulation from Replica (Sidewalk spinout). Synthetic-population mobility modeling giving cities activity-based travel demand data for planning.

How it works: It works by stepping the Nagel-Schreckenberg cellular automaton (accelerate, brake for gap, randomize, move) and measuring average flow.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
